semiconductor_relevance: High — QD Scientific Instruments specializes in advanced measurement systems that are critical for research in semiconductor applications.
summary: Quantum Scientific Instruments (Beijing) Co., Ltd. provides research-grade measurement platforms, including SQUID Magnetic Measurement Systems and Material Comprehensive Property Measurement Systems. These instruments are widely utilized in semiconductor research and development, particularly in the fields of superconductivity and materials science.

regional_presence.China: The company operates as a subsidiary of Quantum Design, focusing on the Chinese market for scientific instruments.
